title: 第二十一章 终回宣武第二十二章 王府门前是非多
content_zh:
“这便是宣武郡吗？”
接连奔波数日，白宣一行终至宣武郡。
白宣远远眺望，未曾入城，便见着一座雄伟的城池出现在自己面前，城墙高大，气势野蛮，好似一头蛰伏的洪荒猛兽，让人望而生畏。
而以白宣的修为，更能看到旁人看不到的东西。
城墙之上，若有若无的阵纹流转，种种晦涩玄妙的气息流转。
背山面水，坐北朝南，四象拱卫，天人合一。
北境气运汇聚于宣武城上空，一个巨大的虚幻阵图凝聚，几乎遮蔽天日。
这哪里是一座城，分明是一座诛妖荡魔阵！
远胜白宣当年所攻破的妖族狼城。
“这是天枢荡魔阵的核心，天枢阵，汇聚北境气运，纵是九境强者入城也要受到压制，不得放肆。”许玉华开口道。
“所以我要学的是这东西。”白宣眼中泛起淡淡异彩。
“不错，接下来，便将一切阵法传授公子，等公子掌握大阵，在这宣武城中，哪怕是天下前三的北荒剑魔亲至，也伤不得公子分毫。”李道衍自信道。
论危险程度，宣武城，仅次于大周皇城与北荒皇城。
外有大阵，内有雄兵。
“好。”白宣闻言，心头涌现一阵欢喜。
主要是归真法有希望了。
我的九曲阵！
“走吧。”
段白语开口道，神色略有复杂。
白宣是第一次来宣武，她却是故地重游。

只是她从未想过，有朝一日回来，竟然是这个光景。
那个她爱了一辈子的男人，如今也永远地闭上了眼睛。
白宣等人当即应是，大军停在外边，少数几人策马疾驰入宣武，有如巨石投入平湖一般，顿时在宣武城中引发轩然大波。
宣武郡，二品镇北将军府。
后花园中，一月牙湖清澈见底，宛若一颗宝石镶嵌在宅中。
湖旁，一个身着白衣的青年，慵懒地靠在椅子上，手中虽握着一根鱼竿，垂钓游鱼，可看那神态似是完全没有在意是否能钓得上鱼来。
“大哥，义父那儿子回来了！”
就在这时，一阵急促的脚步声响起。
只见着两个身形高大的男子疾步入内，一股肃杀之气扑面而来。
池中鱼儿本能地感觉到惶恐，当即惊得四散而去。
“你们两个不在自己的府中呆着，来我府中作甚？都惊了我的鱼。”白衣青年忍不住摇头道。
镇北王侄子，许家年轻一辈第一人。
破荒军统帅，镇北将军许文正。
“大哥，你现在还有心思钓鱼啊？义父死了，镇澜也死了，那小子明摆着回来继承王位，可凭什么？这北境是我们一起守护的，要是镇澜即位，我虽然不服，但也认，可那小子就没有进过军，凭什么统率北境三十万儿郎？”两人中一身形高瘦的男子道。
聂英，镇北王义子。
从三品振威将军。
“说的是啊，大哥，我们应该早做准备。”两人中的另一人亦开口道。
卫锋，镇北王义子。
从三品宣威将军。
“做什么准备？叛变？造反还是架空我那许久没见的好弟弟世安啊？然后，北境动荡，最后给皇城里坐着的那位坐收渔翁之利，随便给我许家扣一个罪名，最后灭我许家满门。”许文正放下鱼竿，看着两个心腹道。
content_en:
"Is this Xuanwu County?"
After running around for several days, Bai Xuan and his party finally arrived at Xuanwu County.
Bai Xuan looked from a distance, and before entering the city, he saw a majestic city appearing in front of him. The city walls were tall and barbaric, like a dormant wild beast, which was intimidating.
And with Bai Xuan's cultivation, he can see things that others cannot see.
On the city wall, there are faint formations flowing, and all kinds of obscure and mysterious auras flow.
With mountains on its back and water on its side, facing south, surrounded by four elephants, it is the unity of heaven and man.
The fortunes of the northern border gathered in the sky above Xuanwu City, and a huge illusory formation formed, almost blocking the sky.
This is not a city, it is clearly a demon-slaying array!
Far better than the Demon Clan Wolf City that Bai Xuan defeated back then.
"This is the core of the Tianshu Dang Demonic Array. The Tianshu Array gathers the fortunes of the northern realm. Even if a strong person from the Nine Realms enters the city, they must be suppressed and must not act arrogantly." Xu Yuhua said.
"So this is what I want to learn." Bai Xuan's eyes flashed with excitement.
"That's right. Next, I will teach the young master all the formation techniques. When the young master masters the formation, in this Xuanwu City, even if the Beihuang Sword Demon, one of the top three in the world, comes in person, he will not be able to hurt the young master at all." Li Daoyan said confidently.
In terms of the degree of danger, Xuanwu City is second only to the Imperial City of the Great Zhou Dynasty and the Imperial City of Beihuang.
There is a large formation outside and powerful soldiers inside.
"Okay." When Bai Xuan heard this, he felt a burst of joy in his heart.
The main reason is that there is hope for the truth.
My Jiuqu Formation!
"Let's go."
Duan Baiyu said with a slightly complicated expression.
It was Bai Xuan's first time to come to Xuanwu, but she was revisiting her old place.
But she never thought that one day she would be in this situation when she came back.
The man she had loved all her life had now closed her eyes forever.
Bai Xuan and others immediately responded. The army stopped outside, and a few people galloped into Xuanwu on horseback. They were like huge rocks thrown into Pinghu, which immediately caused an uproar in Xuanwu City.
Xuanwu County, the general's mansion in the north of Erpin Town.
In the back garden, the Crescent Moon Lake is crystal clear, like a gem embedded in the house.
Beside the lake, a young man dressed in white was lazily leaning on a chair. Although he was holding a fishing rod in his hand and fishing for fish, his expression seemed to be that he didn't care at all whether he could catch fish.
"Brother, my adoptive father's son is back!"
At this moment, a burst of rapid footsteps sounded.
I saw two tall men walking in quickly, and a chilling air hit their faces.
The fish in the pond instinctively felt panic and immediately scattered in all directions.
"Why did you two come to my house if you don't stay in your own house? You all scared me." The young man in white couldn't help but shook his head.
The nephew of the King of Zhenbei, the first member of the younger generation of the Xu family.
The commander-in-chief of the Desolation Army, General Xu Wenzheng of Zhenbei.
"Brother, are you still interested in fishing now? Your foster father is dead, and Zhenlan is also dead. That boy is obviously coming back to inherit the throne, but why? We protect the northern territory together. If Zhenlan takes the throne, although I will not accept it, I will admit it, but that boy has never been in the army, so why should he command three hundred thousand men in the northern territory?" said a tall and thin man among the two.
Nie Ying, the adopted son of the King of Zhenbei.
From the third rank Zhenwei general.
"That's right, brother, we should have made preparations earlier." The other of the two also said.
Wei Feng, the adopted son of the king of Zhenbei.
From the third rank, General Xuanwei.
"What are you preparing for? Rebellion? Rebellion or ousting my good brother Shi'an who I haven't seen for a long time? Then, the northern border is in turmoil. In the end, the man sitting in the imperial city takes advantage of it and accuses my Xu family of a crime, and finally destroys my whole Xu family." Xu Wenzheng put down his fishing rod and looked at his two confidants.
